title: POST a JSON document
summary: Send POST requests with small JSON bodies to a local HTTP/1.1 server over keep-alive connections, eight in flight at a time, and parse each JSON response.
notes: The server is a scripted program in its own process, the same for every entry; its work is not counted. It accepts a request only if its body is, byte for byte, the task's document. An entry keeps its connections open and reuses them; the server counts them. Only the client's process is measured: time spent waiting for the server is not CPU time.
